LegalPrivacy.title: Privacy Notice
LegalPrivacy.metaDescription: Novera Mobility's privacy notice: how your personal data is collected, used and protected.

sections.heading: Data controller
paragraphs: Your personal data is processed by Novera Mobility as the data controller, under the Turkish Personal Data Protection Law no. 6698 (KVKK).
This site belongs to a fictional company; the contact details are examples: kvkk@novera.example.

sections.heading: Personal data we process
paragraphs: Depending on how you use the site, we may process:
list: Identity and contact: first name, last name, email address, phone number.
Booking: pick-up and return location and dates, the chosen car and extras.
Corporate quote: company name, number of cars needed, rental period, car type.
Contact form: your name, email address, phone number (optional), topic and message.
Account: your preferences (language, theme, currency) and the points you earn from your rentals.
Usage: your language, theme and currency preference (through cookies).
Driver eligibility: your date of birth, the country that issued your driving licence, its number and its issue date.

sections.heading: Purposes of processing
list: Creating and managing your booking.
Answering the messages you send through the contact form.
Answering your corporate quote requests.
Managing your account and keeping you signed in.
Working out your points and remembering your preferences with your account.
Remembering your site preferences.
Checking, at the time of booking, that the person who will drive meets the age and driving-licence conditions.

sections.heading: Legal grounds
paragraphs: Your data is processed because it is directly related to the conclusion or performance of a contract, to meet legal obligations, and where necessary for our legitimate interests.

sections.heading: Sharing of data
paragraphs: Your data is not shared with third parties except where the law requires it. We may share it with our hosting and infrastructure providers only as far as necessary.

sections.heading: Retention
paragraphs: Your data is kept for as long as the purpose requires and within the maximum periods set by law, then deleted, destroyed or anonymised.

The date of birth and driving-licence details you enter for the eligibility check are used only for the check while you book; they are not saved to your account, your booking record or your browser, and are not kept afterwards.

sections.heading: Your rights
paragraphs: Under Article 11 of the Law you have the right to:
list: Find out whether your data is processed and request information.
Learn the purpose of processing and whether it is used accordingly.
Request correction if it is incomplete or inaccurate.
Request deletion or destruction.
Claim compensation if you suffer damage.

sections.heading: How to apply
paragraphs: Send your requests to kvkk@novera.example. Applications are answered within thirty days at the latest.

LegalCookies.title: Cookie Policy
LegalCookies.metaDescription: The cookies Novera Mobility uses, what they are for and how to manage your choices.

sections.heading: What is a cookie?
paragraphs: Cookies are small text files saved in your browser when you visit a site. They make the site work properly for you and remember your preferences.

sections.heading: Which cookies do we use?
paragraphs: Novera Mobility only uses functional cookies the site needs to work. We do not use advertising or tracking cookies.

cookies.name: NEXT_LOCALE
cookies.purpose: Remembers your chosen language (Turkish or English).
cookies.duration: Session: until you close the browser.

cookies.name: novera-theme
cookies.purpose: Remembers your chosen appearance (light or dark theme). It is never created if you choose the system setting.

cookies.name: novera-currency
cookies.purpose: Remembers your chosen currency (lira, euro or dollar). It is never created if you do not choose one.

cookies.name: novera-consent
cookies.purpose: Remembers your cookie choice (whether you allowed analytics).

cookies.name: Session cookie
cookies.purpose: Keeps you signed in. It is only created when you use your account.
cookies.duration: For the length of the session.

sections.heading: How can you manage cookies?
paragraphs: You can delete or block cookies in your browser settings. If you block the language, theme and currency cookies, your preferences reset on every visit; the site still works.

sections.heading: Changes
paragraphs: This page is updated whenever a new cookie is added.

LegalTerms.title: Rental Terms
LegalTerms.metaDescription: The terms that apply when you rent a car from Novera Mobility: pick-up, return, insurance and cancellation.

sections.heading: Scope
paragraphs: These terms apply to car rentals made through Novera Mobility. Corporate fleet rentals are governed by the separately signed contract.

sections.heading: What we expect from the renter
list: Be over 18 and hold a valid driving licence (there is no extra age or years-of-licence condition by car class; licences issued in some countries also need an international driving permit).
Present an ID and the driving licence at pick-up.
paragraphs: The age and driving-licence conditions depend on the vehicle class and the country that issued the licence; the condition for the car you pick is shown on the results and summary pages. Your documents are also checked at pick-up.

sections.heading: Booking and payment
paragraphs: Every item in the booking summary is shown openly; there are no hidden fees.
The payment screen on this site is a sample: no real payment is taken and nothing is charged to your card.

sections.heading: Cancellation and changes
paragraphs: You can cancel your booking free of charge up to 24 hours before pick-up. For later cancellations, one day's rental fee may be charged.

sections.heading: Pick-up and return
list: The car is handed over at the location and time stated in the booking.
It is returned at the agreed location and time; returning to a different location must be chosen while booking.
The car is returned with the fuel level it was collected with.
Late returns are charged for the extra time.

sections.heading: Road Assurance
paragraphs: Every rental is covered by Road Assurance: a 24/7 support line, tow truck dispatch and a replacement car if a breakdown lasts more than 24 hours.

sections.heading: Liability and damage
paragraphs: The renter must drive the car in line with traffic rules and its intended use. In case of damage a report is drawn up; coverage depends on the chosen assurance package.

sections.heading: Prohibited use
list: Racing, drifting or driver training.
Subletting the car or letting third parties drive it.
Carrying commercial goods or passengers for hire.

sections.heading: Disputes
paragraphs: Disputes are first settled by good-faith discussion; if none is found, the competent courts and enforcement offices have jurisdiction.

LegalPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
LegalPolicy.metaDescription: What information Novera Mobility collects when you use the site, why, and how it protects it.

sections.heading: In short
paragraphs: We only take the information needed to provide the service, we do not sell it, and we do not share it with third parties for advertising. The legal detail is in the Privacy Notice (KVKK); this page says the same in plain words.

sections.heading: What information do we collect?
list: Your account: your first name, last name and email address; company details for a corporate account.
Your bookings: dates, locations, the car and extras you chose.
Forms: what you write in the contact and corporate quote forms.
Your preferences: language, theme and currency.
Your points: the points you earn from your rentals.

sections.heading: What do we use it for?
list: Making your booking and getting in touch with you.
Answering your questions and quote requests.
Remembering your account and preferences.
Working out your points.

sections.heading: Payment details
paragraphs: The payment screen on this site is a sample: your card details are not stored and no money is taken from your card.

sections.heading: Cookies
paragraphs: We use cookies to remember your language, theme and currency choice and your session. The details are in the Cookie Policy.

sections.heading: How do we protect it, and for how long do we keep it?
paragraphs: Access to your data is limited to authorised staff. We keep it for as long as its purpose needs, then delete or anonymise it. You can delete your account on the Settings page.

sections.heading: Get in touch
paragraphs: For questions about privacy you can write to kvkk@novera.example.

LegalSiteTerms.title: Terms of Use
LegalSiteTerms.metaDescription: The terms that apply when you use the Novera Mobility site: accounts, content, liability and changes.

sections.heading: Scope
paragraphs: These terms govern the use of the Novera Mobility website. The terms of renting a car are on the Rental Terms page.

sections.heading: Using the site
list: You use the site only for lawful purposes.
You are responsible for the information you give in the forms being correct.
Use that harms the site, disrupts access or collects data in bulk with automated tools is not allowed.

sections.heading: Your account
paragraphs: You are responsible for the security of your account; do not share your sign-in details. You open an individual account yourself, while Novera opens a corporate account after a sales conversation.

sections.heading: Points
paragraphs: Points are earned with completed rentals; cancelled bookings earn none. If the points rule changes, it will be announced on this page.

sections.heading: Content and prices
paragraphs: The text, images and logos on the site belong to Novera Mobility. Prices include VAT; the amount in the booking summary applies. Currency conversions use the daily rate.

sections.heading: Limits of liability
paragraphs: We work to keep the site running without interruption or error but cannot guarantee it. We are not liable for indirect loss from temporary access problems caused by maintenance or faults.

sections.heading: Changes
paragraphs: We may update these terms; the current version is always on this page. Continuing to use the site after an update means you accept the new terms.
